capabilities: Open Mermaid diagrams in a full-size modal by clicking
Pan and zoom diagrams with scroll, drag, and preset zoom levels
Export diagrams as high-resolution PNG images
Inject custom CSS into Mermaid diagram appearance
Toggle readability enhancements and configure modal size, zoom, and language
disambiguation: Not a diagram editor or renderer replacement; it only adds viewing controls to already rendered Mermaid diagrams.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later; sideloaded installs on older versions get a blank settings tab. Works on desktop and mobile with touch-specific controls.
intentEvidence: enhances Mermaid diagram viewing experience with click-to-zoom, pan & zoom controls, and PNG export
problem: Obsidian's built-in Mermaid rendering shows diagrams at fixed size with no zoom, pan, or export options, which makes large diagrams hard to read.

relations.evidence: enhances Mermaid diagram viewing experience with click-to-zoom, pan & zoom controls, and PNG export

summary: Mermaid viewer enhancement that opens diagrams in a click-to-zoom modal with pan and zoom controls, PNG export, and custom CSS.
